cfs.subject: tokenizer mode switching rule (command vs expression mode, when it switches)
cfs.statement: **Mode rule.** The tokenizer starts in Command mode; the parser switches to Expression mode when it parses an expression operand/operator position (including the first element of a pipeline when it is not a command), to Command mode when it parses a command's arguments or the body of `{ }`, `( )`, `$( )`, to TypeName mode inside `[...]` type literals, and to Signature mode for class/enum/method headers; every switch is restored in a `finally` block, and a switch discards and rescans a pending lookahead token unless its kind is `ParseModeInvariant`.
cfs.label: FACT-SRC

cfs.subject: numeric-literal rules (radix, suffixes, multipliers)
cfs.statement: **Numeric literal rules.** A number is an optional sign (`-`, en/em dash/horizontal bar, or `+`; only when `AllowSignedNumbers`), then either `.digits[exponent]`, `0x` hex digits, `0b` binary digits, or decimal digits with optional `.digits` and `e/E[+|-]digits`; then an optional type suffix (`u s l d y n`, plus a second character only after `u`: `ul us uy`), then an optional multiplier `k m g t p` that **must be followed by `b`/`B`** (powers of 1024; the suffix comes before the multiplier); the literal must be followed by a token terminator (in Expression mode also by a binary-operator start character) or the text is not a number and is rescanned as a generic token. Value typing: no suffix → `int`, else `long`, else (decimal format only) `decimal`, else `double`; real literals → `double` unless suffix `d` (`decimal`); hex and binary are two's complement with the sign decided by the top digit (`0xFFFFFFFF` → `-1`, `0xFF` → `255`), a 16-hex-digit or 64-bit-digit literal without `u` becomes `long`; the multiplier is applied to the value before the range cast and failure to fit returns `false` (reported as `BadNumericConstant` in Expression mode, otherwise the text becomes a generic token).
cfs.label: FACT-SRC

deviations.baseline_behavior: Tokenizer detects signature-block lookalikes and processes #requires comment lines at parse time.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Omit both from the tokenizer; if wanted, handle pragmas in a dedicated post-tokenize pass.
deviations.benefit: Keeps the tokenizer a pure text-to-token function; removes security-sensitive fuzzy matching from the hot path.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Scripts using #requires get no version/module check; signed-script trailer detection unavailable.
